correctness.rationale: The primitive-rotation-class upper bound follows from self-unborderedness and the unavoidable proper overlap between distinct rotations. An exact 1296-case six-necklace transversal test reduces the 40-class upper bound to 39 at length twelve; every single deletion of one of those six classes admits a compatible five-transversal. Explicit length-4-through-12 codebooks reach 0,1,2,5,8,14,20,30,39 and the standalone standard-library verifier checks each defining prefix-suffix condition and every primitive necklace count. value.rationale: The primitive-necklace packing ceiling is a natural structural bound for fixed-composition synchronization codes. Exhaustively locating its first failure for weight four, after attainment at every shorter length, identifies an exact motivated cutoff and an irredundant six-necklace obstruction. The result supplies a stand-alone optimal codebook and a small verifiable explanation of the deficit, without asserting larger-length extrapolations.
